# Catalogue coverage — what the Page Designer can and cannot name

*Generated by `scripts/design-coverage-sweep.mjs`. Do not hand-edit — re-run it.*

Every admin route is opened signed-in at 1440px and walked with the same function the
importer uses (`scripts/lib/design-capture.mjs`). Each element is matched against the
catalogue. What follows is what the pages themselves say they wear.

- **133 routes measured**, 50 catalogue entries
- **11036 elements** found; **5926** matched no entry
- **≈46% of rendered elements are catalogued**
- 1 route(s) could not be measured (listed at the end)

## What to curate next

Ranked by **how many routes** each unnamed class appears on, not by how many times it is
rendered. A class on 40 pages is one entry that makes 40 pages designable; a class on one
page may never need an entry at all. A static CSS scan cannot tell you this — a
stylesheet does not know how many pages render it.
